alt: A Google Drive folder shared with a service account, where Google Docs are read as Markdown, Sheets as CSV, Slides as plain text, other files as-is and subfolders recursively, is chunked with RecursiveSplitter and embedded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 into the Postgres table coco_examples_v1.doc_embeddings (id, filename, text, embedding); an edited Doc re-derives only its rows on the next run, and the query "what is self-attention?" searches the Drive by meaning.

run.note: Set the key path and folder ids in .env, then install
Scan the folders and build the index; re-run for changes
